findings.reason: `session.current` holds the last composed ExternalSurface whose handlers close over the ProjectContext live at the session's last request. After invalidation/detach an idle open session keeps the released (disposed, FDs closed) predecessor reachable — not GC-able — until its next request re-syncs or the 30-min idle reap. Pre-existing; the new header overclaims. Remedy: on release, drop session surfaces bound to the released context (lazily re-resolving stub). U7's per-cycle memory measurement should account for this.
